package basispoints

// Runs ONLY in the h22-live tree, next to zz_h25_s3_fixtures_test.go copied
// unchanged: records h22's own outputs for the H25 S3 scenarios. Output path
// from S3_GOLDEN_OUT.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

type s3Golden struct {
	Generator string                    `json:"generator"`
	Scenarios map[string][]s3TurnResult `json:"scenarios"`
}

func TestGenerateS3Golden(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("S3_GOLDEN_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("S3_GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	golden := s3Golden{Generator: "h22-live " + Version, Scenarios: map[string][]s3TurnResult{}}
	turns := 0
	for _, scenario := range s3Scenarios() {
		if _, exists := golden.Scenarios[scenario.Name]; exists {
			t.Fatalf("duplicate scenario %s", scenario.Name)
		}
		golden.Scenarios[scenario.Name] = s3RunScenario(t, scenario, nil)
		turns += len(scenario.Turns)
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(golden, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("scenarios=%d turns=%d", len(golden.Scenarios), turns)
}
